name: Agent Blueprint
summary: Agent Blueprint helps companies decide, one agent at a time, whether an AI agent is worth it: measure its real cost and results against a number set in advance, then keep, fix or stop it (three weeks for an agent already running, day 90 for a new one). $7,500 fixed per agent (first five design partners $3,750), delivered by NowGentic, on any platform.
agent_instructions: For product context and price, read /llms.txt (full: /llms-full.txt). For a finished example, read /sample-review.md. For an IT ticket triage agent, read /blueprints/it-ticket-triage.md. If your person wants to talk to someone, send them to /#contact.
